name: L10 SEVN portal-conditioned OCR fresh PAN Development
question: When frozen V2 cannot read the requested house number, can a portal-conditioned credential observation recover exact text and correct door binding on forty fresh addresses without overriding any V2 proposal?

cohort.disjointness: No address or panorama frame may overlap either earlier SEVN panel; no frame may be reused across fresh episodes.

runtime.ocr_backend: RapidOCR through ONNX Runtime using the frozen PP-OCRv6 model files
runtime.comparison_note: Both arms run in this same frozen successor runtime. The baseline arm preserves the V2 code and pixel contract by hash; it is a contemporaneous comparator rather than a claim that the older package environment was recreated.

successor_observation.trigger: Run only when the V2 baseline state is UNKNOWN_TARGET_TEXT and at least one V2 portal mask survives.
successor_observation.portal_order: Descending frozen portal confidence, then stable candidate ID.
successor_observation.credential_region: Reuse the V2 adaptive upper-mask association neighborhood: mask x bounds plus the frozen horizontal radius, and mask top through the frozen upper cutoff plus the frozen vertical radius.
successor_observation.resize: Aspect-preserving bicubic resize to a canonical 1280-pixel long side, capped at four times magnification; map OCR polygons back into the original viewport.
successor_observation.recognizer: Reuse the exact frozen PP-OCRv6 weights, minimum score 0.5, exact alphanumeric token equality, and deduplication contract from V2.
successor_observation.binding: Join recovered exact tokens to the unchanged V2 portal masks with the unchanged upper-mask topology and truth-blind ranking.
successor_observation.asymmetry: Never run the new branch after a V2 proposal or a V2 exact-token topology failure. Never replace, rerank, or revoke a baseline proposal.

representation_boundary: The only algorithmic change is a deficit-triggered portal-conditioned OCR observation field. Renderer, prescribed actions, public mission, OCR weights, exact-token threshold, portal weights and postprocessor, masks, association topology, evaluator truth projection, and correctness rules stay fixed. No text super-resolution generator, language correction, target-conditioned hallucination, new detector, or evaluator label enters inference.
execution_rule: Freeze source, evaluator, runtime, parameters, hashes, metrics, and gates before opening any selected panorama member. Run one output-bearing invocation. Do not tune crops, limits, scale, OCR, topology, models, gates, cohort, or runtime after observing results.
non_claims: The fresh panel is same-source SEVN and PAN-only; it does not confirm a new city, new provider, or APPROACH behavior.
The evaluator prescribes the action and supplies door/text truth only after both runtime outputs are sealed in memory.
An exact house-number-to-mask proposal is not portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
A failed gate closes only this frozen portal-conditioned observation representation on this cohort; it does not make UNKNOWN negative evidence.
